findings.summary: Spec required behavior #5 unmet: no pointer to quota-api `:8101/api/quotas` was added in the /quota response or in any doc. The retire behavior itself works, but future maintainers have no in-product breadcrumb that lingzhi quota moved to quota-api.

Spec required behavior #4 (/data/cc-switch/cc-switch.env LINGZHI_ACCESS_TOKEN cleanup) targets a runtime file outside this repo and cannot be satisfied by a code commit; it is a deployment step verified by the spec's live-system grep, not Implementer product work.
